description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את הכיסוי לעלויות ניקיון ואחריות הקשורות לאירועי זיהום קיימים במסגרת פוליסת ביטוח עסקית. הכיסוי מותנה במיקום הגילוי והתביעות, וכן בתקופת הפוליסה. הפוליסה עוסקת בתביעות הנובעות מ״אירוע זיהום קיים״, הן בתוך גבולות ״מיקום מכוסה״ והן מחוצה להם. ניתן לבדוק את הכיסוי עבור ״עלויות ניקיון״, ״פציעות גופניות״ ו״נזק לרכוש״. הפוליסה מתייחסת גם ל״תביעה״, ״מבוטח״ ו״גילוי״ של האירוע. ביטוח אחריות זיהום מכסה נזקים שנגרמו כתוצאה מאירועי זיהום קיימים.

(b) Third Party Liability
We will pay 'cleanup costs' that an 'insured' is legally obligated to pay as a result  of  a  "claim"  resulting  from  an  'existing  pollution  event'  that  migrates beyond the boundaries from a 'covered location', provided the "claim" is first made  against  the  "insured"  during  the  'policy  period",  and  the  "claim"  is reported to us in writing during the 'policy period' or any applicable extended reporting period.
Unless covered under any other insuring agreement specifically listed as provided in Item 5 of the Declarations, we shall have no obligation to pay any "cleanup costs" attributable  to  any  irritant,  contaminant  or  pollutant  that  is  on,  at  or  under  a "covered location".

טבלה: ביטוח אחריות זיהום
This table details coverage for cleanup costs and liability related to existing pollution events under a business insurance policy. It specifies conditions for coverage based on the location of discovery and claims.
ממדים: Coverage scenarios (On-Site/Off-Site, First Party/Third Party), Coverage conditions and types of costs (Cleanup Costs, Bodily Injury, Property Damage)

(b) Third Party Liability
We will pay 'cleanup costs' that an 'insured' is legally obligated to pay as a result  of  a  "claim"  resulting  from  an  'existing  pollution  event'  that  migrates beyond the boundaries from a 'covered location', provided the "claim" is first made  against  the  "insured"  during  the  'policy  period",  and  the  "claim"  is reported to us in writing during the 'policy period' or any applicable extended reporting period.
Unless covered under any other insuring agreement specifically listed as provided in Item 5 of the Declarations, we shall have no obligation to pay any "cleanup costs" attributable  to  any  irritant,  contaminant  or  pollutant  that  is  on,  at  or  under  a "covered location".
